/-
  What the explorer may write (task 41714c0d, D85, D93): a comment on a definition or a change, a task, or a comment
  on a task, each checked here and turned into the request `deus inbox` applies. platform/worker/worker.mjs checks
  who is writing, and that each attachment was uploaded, before it asks.
-/
/-- `value` when it is a string, cut to `limit` characters; anything else is "". -/
def Worker.Writes.text (value : Js) (limit : Int) : Text := if Js.typeOf value == "string" then Text.take limit (Js.toText value) else ""
